name: is_capability_skill
why: escalation must be invoked by orchestrating skills at documented triggers, never auto-fire from a user prompt

name: four_triggers_enumerated
why: the trigger vocabulary is the contract the orchestrators emit and the cap counts by

name: respects_escalation_enabled
why: escalation is a config opt-out; a disabled project must fall back to AskUserQuestion

name: enforces_per_sprint_cap
why: the cap keeps escalation a scalpel — count prior consult events before dispatching

name: counts_consults_via_scan_events
why: the cap is enforced against the event log, not session memory

name: reads_think_tier_from_config
why: the consult model comes from config; empty value = omit model: and inherit

name: omit_model_when_unset
why: an empty tier must not become a hardcoded model — omission inherits the session model

name: emits_dispatch_event_first
why: a consult that leaves no audit trace cannot be capped or diagnosed

name: emits_return_event
why: close the audit pair so /ship-status and diagnose can see consult outcomes

name: consult_is_read_only
why: the consult recommends; the orchestrator executes — a mutating consult would bypass the pipeline's gates

name: structured_return_contract
why: the orchestrator parses the return; free-prose recommendations are unactionable

name: gates_beat_consults
why: a consult recommendation must never become authority to bypass terminal/integration/loop-leak gates

name: documented_recovery_paths_first
why: escalation is for reasoning gaps the documented playbooks don't cover, not a shortcut around them
